turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
or duties?

Yes, SPANX ships internationally! 🌟 We currently ship to the US (including APO/FPO/DPO and territories), Canada (via SPANX.ca), the UK, and many countries across Europe like France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and more.

Good news on customs, all taxes and duties are included at checkout for these countries, so there are no extra fees charged upon delivery.

If your country isn't on that list yet, you're welcome to email contactus@spanx.com to let them know you'd love to see SPANX there!

How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping takes 1-5 business days for processing, plus transit time, so the full timeline is about 5-9 business days from when you place your order to delivery. 🌟 It's free on orders $75+ or for Icon Rewards members, otherwise it's $7.00. Just a note, orders to APO/FPO/DPO addresses or US territories can take up to 30 days due to transit time. Let me know if there's anything more I can assist with.

Do you price match or honor a price drop after purchase?

Yes, we can honor a price drop after purchase in many cases. If your order was placed within 30 days and the exact item is currently in stock in your size and color at the lower price, we can process a price adjustment to your original payment method. Shipping charges are not included in the adjustment.

If you want me to check a specific order, send your order number or the email used at checkout.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?

For defective or damaged items, SPANX handles those separately from a standard return.

If the item was purchased from SPANX.com, the usual path is a replacement or refund for a confirmed quality issue. In most cases, clear photos of the damage are required before that can be processed. The one exception is an odor issue, that can be handled without photos.

A few key details:

The standard coverage window for defective-item replacement is within 1 year of the order date
If the item is in stock, the usual resolution is a replacement
If it is out of stock, the usual resolution is a refund
Final sale items can still be eligible if the issue is a confirmed manufacturing defect
Washed items are reviewed case by case, they are not automatically denied

For regular returns, items damaged by misuse, alterations, improper care, or accidents are not eligible under the standard return policy.

If you want, I can also walk you through the exact steps for a defective-item claim.
